hooks.command: if [ -d docs/ai-cto ]; then echo "🔄 docs/ai-cto/ 项目记忆（指针模式：正文不注入，避免 trust 前读项目本地文件 + 省 context）"; for f in CONSTITUTION.md STATUS.md DECISIONS.md COUNTS.md; do [ -f "docs/ai-cto/$f" ] && echo "   · $f  (更新 $(date -r "docs/ai-cto/$f" +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || echo ?))"; done; if [ -f docs/ai-cto/REVIEW-QUEUE.md ]; then echo "   · REVIEW-QUEUE.md  最近一条: $(grep "^## 20" docs/ai-cto/REVIEW-QUEUE.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | cut -c4-70)"; fi; echo "   红线由 hooks 强制执行，不依赖本次注入。用 /cto-resume 按需加载正文。"; else echo "🆕 未检测到 docs/ai-cto/ 项目记忆 — 运行 /cto-start（第零轮）或 /cto-init <路径>（安装）"; fi
if [ -d .claude/hooks ] && ls .claude/hooks/*-guard.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '⚙️ enforcement hooks 已部署。运行 /cto-doctor 验证真生效。'; fi

test -d .claude/agent-logs && DAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) && TS=$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || date) && printf '{"ts":"%s","schema":"v3.8","event":"SubagentStop"}\n' "$TS" >> .claude/agent-logs/${DAY}.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true
echo '⚠️ 即将压缩上下文。建议先把当前 spec/PLAN/决策保存到 docs/ai-cto/STATUS.md，避免压缩丢失。'
echo '— 会话结束摘要 —'; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20

[ "${CTO_AUTOREVIEW_ON_STOP:-1}" = "1" ] && test -x .agents/skills/codex-bridge/run.sh && bash .agents/skills/codex-bridge/run.sh HEAD && echo '🔄 §48 cross-review + PR autopilot 已在后台触发。结果稍后出现在 docs/ai-cto/REVIEW-QUEUE.md 和 PR comment。关闭：export CTO_AUTOREVIEW_ON_STOP=0' || true
echo "♻️ 上下文已压缩。项目记忆仍在 docs/ai-cto/（CONSTITUTION / STATUS / DECISIONS / COUNTS），红线仍由 hooks 强制；需要细节用 /cto-resume 重新加载，不要凭压缩后的残留记忆下判断。"
